content:
From the graph, the only break occurs at \(x=-1\).

- As \(x\to -1^{-}\), the graph approaches the open circle at \(y=3\), so  
  \[
  \lim_{x\to -1^-}f(x)=3.
  \]
- As \(x\to -1^{+}\), the graph approaches the filled point at \(y=-3\), so  
  \[
  \lim_{x\to -1^+}f(x)=-3.
  \]

Because the one-sided limits are not equal, \(f\) has a jump discontinuity at \(x=-1\).

\[
\boxed{x=-1}
\]
